text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Trainer. I have returned.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I was able to run largely
within my
predicted parameters.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I would like to maintain this momentum
and
prepare for my next race—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Only one month remains until the
Japanese
Derby. I must continue training
according to
schedule...

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text:
You would be super, toll und klasse,
Flash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our way home, Eishin Flash searches
up the
term "Derby rankings" on her
phone.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Searching posts on Umatter. It's a good
way to track the general consensus on
racers as the
public posts things in real
time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I'm curious to see if public opinion of me
has
changed after the Satsuki Sho...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There, the search is complete. The
number of hits
is staggering...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Take your broken dreams and turn them
into
victory!" "You'll beat your rival next
time!" Nearly all seem to be support
messages for other Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
What if I enter "Derby" and "Eishin
Flash"
instead?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There are 3,190 hits. However, most
seem to be
general evaluations that
don't reference me
directly.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It seems everyone has a special
attachment to the
Derby because of its
importance to those
involved.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Not just to me. To everyone.
choice_data_list: It's a special race for you, too.
It's a special race for you, too.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Everyone being judged right now has
their own
special reason for running the
Derby.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: The way things are at present...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash's voice trails off as she
settles quietly
with her thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And thus, I have drafted a training
schedule
intended to enhance my
capabilities across the
board.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day after the Satsuki Sho, Eishin
Flash hands me an updated schedule.
The best way to
describe it is "downright
terrifying."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Each one should have eighteen
participants running in a 2400-meter
race to mimic actual
race conditions as
closely as possible.
choice_data_list: A practice race every single week?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I compiled a list of prospective runners,
all of whom have competed at the G1
level. With your
permission, I will
contact them myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even if they're "just" scrimmages, a race
is still a
race. She'll run herself ragged if
she participates in so many on top of her
usual training regimen.
choice_data_list: That puts way too much strain on y...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
But I don't stand out from the crowd at
the
moment, so I must improve my odds.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Obtaining as much experience as
possible is the only way I can achieve
perfect results at the
Derby in such a
short amount of time.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. While I cannot improve my own
abilities
rapidly, I can quickly gain lots
of experience.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
And to do that, I must run in as many
scrimmages
as possible. That is the only
path to victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash's argument makes sense to a
certain
point, but it's utterly impractical.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want you to train me to the point
that this
schedule becomes realistically
achievable.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I am aware of my own limitations. I
cannot
realize these dreams on my own.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is why I sought your help. Please
train me to become the perfect version
of myself, one worthy
of executing this
perfect plan.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now more than ever is the time to live
up to my
title as a trainer.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...How long is this "moment"? As I stated
before,
the Derby is fast-approaching.
choice_data_list: Mind if I hold onto this matter fo...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Very well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I shall confer with you again in two days.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Our next goal is the Japanese Derby...
but
something comes up that we have to
take care of
first.
